script.title: THE DETERGENT AISLE
script.story_hook: A beeping washer sent her to the detergent aisle.
script.intro_zh: 一台亂叫的洗衣機，帶你走進鎮上最大的洗衣精貨架。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the laundry aisle today. Listen for shopping and product words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的洗衣用品走道。留意購物和產品的說法。
script.outro: Right soap, right machine, coupon applied. Listen twice and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 選對洗潔精、用對機器、還用了優惠券。聽兩遍再逐句跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now echo each aisle line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請跟著我逐句跟讀走道對話。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful woman in her fifties with short silver-cropped hair, a lavender cardigan over a small-floral blouse, brown ankle boots, a plump friendly build
script.char_b_description: a college-age man in his early twenties with curly black hair under a backwards store cap, a red T-shirt under an open green staff vest, a name tag on the chest, a lean tall build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my washer keeps beeping at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ ˈwɑʃɚ kipz ˈbipɪŋ æt mi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的洗衣機一直對著我嗶嗶叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beeping? Which brand do you have?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbipɪŋ wɪtʃ ˈbrænd du ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 嗶嗶叫？你的洗衣機是哪個牌子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some high-efficiency model, um, top loader.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˌhaɪ ɪˈfɪʃənsi ˈmɑdəl ʌm tɑp ˈloʊdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 什麼高效率型，嗯，上開式的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, what detergent are you using?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt dɪˈtɝdʒənt ɑɹ ju ˈjuzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那妳用的是哪種洗衣精？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big blue liquid, the famous one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ blu ˈlɪkwəd ðə ˈfeɪməs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 就是那大瓶的藍色液態洗衣精，很有名的那款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, does the bottle say HE anywhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dʌz ðə ˈbɑɾəl seɪ ˌeɪtʃˈiː ˈɛnɪwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那瓶子上有任何地方寫著 HE 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me look... no, it doesn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk noʊ ɪt dʌˈzʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……沒有，沒寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's probably your beeping friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈpɹɑbəbli jɔɹ ˈbipɪŋ fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那大概就是你那位愛嗶嗶的朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So regular soap is bad for my machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɹɛɡjələr soʊp ɪz bæd fɚ maɪ məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 所以一般洗衣精對我機器不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes too many suds for HE washers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪks tu ˈmɛni sʌdz fɚ ˌeɪtʃˈiː ˈwɑʃɚz/
dialogue.zh: 它對高效洗衣機來說泡沫太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too many suds? I thought more foam meant cleaner.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɛni sʌdz aɪ θɔt mɔɹ foʊm mɛnt ˈklinəɚ/
dialogue.zh: 泡沫太多？我以為泡泡越多洗得越乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic myth! HE detergents make fewer suds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk mɪθ ˌeɪtʃˈiː dɪˈtɝdʒənts meɪk ˈfjuɚ sʌdz/
dialogue.zh: 經典迷思！HE 洗衣精的泡沫反而更少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find those around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹ du aɪ faɪnd ðoʊz əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 在這店裡要去哪兒找那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle six, all the green HE labels.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɪks ɔl ðə ɡɹin ˌeɪtʃˈiː ˈleɪbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 六號走道，綠色 HE 標籤的都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Now, pods or liquid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt naʊ pɑdz ɔɹ ˈlɪkwəd/
dialogue.zh: 好。再來，要用膠囊還是液態的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's easier for you day to day?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ˈiziɚ fɚ ju deɪ tə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 平常哪種對妳比較方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, my hands get tired easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli maɪ hændz ɡɛt ˈtaɪɹd ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我的手很容易累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pods, they're pre-measured, zero mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɑdz ðɛrz pɹi ˈmɛʒɚd ˈzɪɹoʊ mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那就膠囊，用量都配好，也不會髒手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But aren't pods pricier per load?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ɑɹənt pɑdz ˈpɹaɪsiɚ pɚ loʊd/
dialogue.zh: 但膠囊洗一趟不是比較貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, yes: about thirty-five cents each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl jɛs əˈbaʊt ˈθɝɾi faɪv sɛnts itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，一顆大約三毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the liquid works out cheaper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈlɪkwəd wɝks aʊt ˈtʃipɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那液態的算下來比較便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around twenty cents, but you have to measure.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɹaʊnd ˈtwɛnti sɛnts bʌt ju hæv tə ˈmɛʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一趟約兩毛，但妳要自己量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandson measures with his eyes, always too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡɹænsʌn ˈmɛʒɚz wɪð hɪz aɪz ˈɔlweɪz tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我孫子都用眼睛量，每次都倒太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, kids love the pouring job.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kɪdz lʌv ðə ˈpɔɹɪŋ dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 哈，小孩最愛倒洗衣精這工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question: any fragrance-free option?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ ˈkwɛstʃən ˈɛni ˈfɹeɪɡrəns fri ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 再問一個：有無香精的選項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the purple box is dye and scent free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈpɝpəl bɑks ɪz daɪ ænd sɛnt fri/
dialogue.zh: 有，紫色那盒不含色素和香精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is free-and-clear the same thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈfɹiːn ænd klɪɹ ðə seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: free-and-clear 是同一回事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basically yes: no dye, no perfume.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbesɪkli jɛs noʊ daɪ noʊ pɚˈfjum/
dialogue.zh: 基本上是的：無色素、無香精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my shoulders get itchy from perfume.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ ˈʃoʊldɚz ɡɛt ˈɪtʃi fɹʌm pɚˈfjum/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我一碰到香精肩膀就癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free-and-clear is the gentle pick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹiːn ænd klɪɹ ɪz ðə ˈdʒɛntəl pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 無香精那款是最溫柔的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll go with purple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪl ɡoʊ wɪð ˈpɝpəl/
dialogue.zh: 完美，那我就選紫色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's grab a box... oh, that's strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ləts ɡɹæb ə bɑks oʊ ðæts streɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 來拿一盒……噢，這有點奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's strange?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts streɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼奇怪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf is empty... we're sold out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf ɪz ˈɛmpi wɪɹ soʊld aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 貨架空了……我們賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold out? What a bummer.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld aʊt wʌt ə ˈbʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 賣完了？真掃興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang on, pods come in bags too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɑn pɑdz kʌm ɪn bæɡz tu/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，膠囊也有包裝袋的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do those work in the same machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðoʊz wɝk ɪn ðə seɪm məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 那種可以用在同一台機器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same formula, just cheaper packaging.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪm ˈfɔrmjələ dʒʌst ˈtʃipɚ ˈpækədʒɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，配方一樣，只是包裝比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like cheaper packaging, less trash too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ˈtʃipɚ ˈpækədʒɪŋ lɛs tɹæʃ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我愛便宜包裝，垃圾也比較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? Here's the family-size bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹz ðə ˈfæməl saɪz bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 對吧？這是家庭號大包裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many loads in that bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni loʊdz ɪn ðæt bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那一袋可以洗幾趟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety-two loads, lasts you forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti tu loʊdz læsts ju fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 九十二趟，可以用到永遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forever is good, I hate shopping twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɛvɚ ɪz ɡʊd aɪ heɪt ˈʃɑpɪŋ twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 永遠很好，我最討厭跑兩趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here. There's also a coupon.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪɹ ðɛɹz ˈɔɫsoʊ ə ˈkupɑn/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。這還有優惠券可以折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do I need the store app?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt du aɪ nid ðə stɔɹ æp/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我要用商店的 App 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, um, I can help you load it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm aɪ kæn hɛp ju loʊd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，我可以幫妳下載。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At my age, apps are gymnastics.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt maɪ eɪdʒ æpz ɑɹ dʒɪmˈnæstɪks/
dialogue.zh: 到我這年紀，用 App 像是在做體操。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's three taps, look, I'll show you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz θɹi tæps lʊk aɪl ʃoʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 只要點三下，來，我示範給妳看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, there it is! One dollar off?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛɹ ɪt ɪz wʌn ˈdɑɫɚ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 噢，出來了！可以折一美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars off the bag, nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdɑɫɚz ɔf ðə bæɡ naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這一袋折兩美元，不錯吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better. Does it stack with my points?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ dʌz ɪt stæk wɪð maɪ pɔɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 更好。可以和我的點數併用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, points and coupons love each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp pɔɪnts ænd ˈkupɑnz lʌv itʃ ˈʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，點數和優惠券相處得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I wish my bills were this friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ wɪʃ maɪ bɪlz wɝ ðɪs ˈfɹɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，希望我的帳單也這麼友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, that's how shopping trips get long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛɹfʊl ðæts haʊ ˈʃɑpɪŋ tɹɪps ɡɛt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 小心，購物行程就是這樣變長的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth it though. Here, ring me up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɝθ ɪt ðoʊ hɪɹ ɹɪŋ mi ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 不過值得啦。來，幫我結帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's twenty-seven ninety-eight with the coupon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ˈnɪnti eɪt wɪð ðə ˈkupɑn/
dialogue.zh: 折完優惠券是二十七塊九毛八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And those free samples by the register?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðoʊz fri ˈsæmpəlz baɪ ðə ˈɹɛdʒɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台那邊的免費試用包呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know the deal! Here, grab four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ ðə dil hɪɹ ɡɹæb fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 妳懂門路！來，拿四包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, you're generous. Thank you, sweetie.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ jʊɹ ˈdʒɛnɚəs θæŋk ju ˈswiɾi/
dialogue.zh: 四包，你真大方。謝謝你，孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hope the beeping stops. Come back anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊp ðə ˈbipɪŋ stɑps kʌm bæk ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 希望它不再嗶嗶叫。歡迎隨時再來。

script.youtube_title: 【超市洗衣精🧺】「我的洗衣機一直嗶嗶叫」一雙愛癢的肩膀選出對的洗潔精🫧✨🎧｜聽完就會自己挑｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Choosing Laundry Detergent
script.youtube_title_en: "My Washer Keeps Beeping" — Choosing the Right Detergent at the Store
script.youtube_description:
「泡沫太多？我以為泡泡越多洗得越乾淨。」高效洗衣機一直嗶嗶叫，答案可能就在洗潔精上。這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，場景就在超市的洗衣用品走道。

你會聽到：怎麼向店員描述機器的怪毛病（My washer keeps beeping at me.）；HE 低泡配方、膠囊和液態的價格比較；無香精選項怎麼問、貨架空了怎麼辦；還有商店 App、優惠券和點數合併使用的完整對話。

整段都是 A2 初級短句，都是美式自然語感：hang on、yep、same here、what a bummer。聽完你就會用：Which brand do you have?、Do those work in the same machine?、Ring me up、Come back anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次站在貨架前就會自己選。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Too many suds? I thought more foam meant cleaner." When a high-efficiency washer starts beeping, the answer may be sitting on the detergent shelf. This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a supermarket laundry aisle.

You will hear: describing a quirky machine problem to a clerk (My washer keeps beeping at me.); HE low-suds formulas and the pods-versus-liquid price math; asking for fragrance-free options when a shelf is sold out; and using a store app, a coupon, and points together at the register.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences with natural American fillers like hang on, yep, same here, what a bummer. By the end you'll own phrases like Which brand do you have?, Ring me up, and Come back anytime.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and pick your own bottle next time.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧超市英文｜HE低泡配方・膠囊vs液態・無香精選法｜空了怎麼辦？優惠券怎麼折？｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
洗衣機一直嗶嗶叫，洗衣用品架上琳瑯滿目卻讓妳眼花撩亂，從哪一句開始問起？

這一集帶大家走進超市的洗衣用品走道，從描述機器的怪聲音、認識 HE 低泡配方，到膠囊對液態的單次成本、無香精選項、賣完時的備案和優惠券，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧺 開門見山：Hi, my washer keeps beeping at me.
🫧 學新知識：Too many suds? I thought more foam meant cleaner.
💸 比價格：A little, yes: about thirty-five cents each.
📱 用優惠券：Does it stack with my points?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 hang on、yep、what a bummer 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這位阿嬤走一趟，下次站在洗衣精貨架前，選擇題就變成送分題。

祝妳每一桶衣服，都香香剛剛好。
script.thumbnail_action: holding a pod bag and a liquid bottle side by side
